item.title: Umisora no Fragments
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: rootnuko
  • 発売日: 2014-04-25
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (61 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 海空のフラグメンツ
  • 英語名: Umisora no Fragments

别名

  • umifra

あらすじ

When he was small, Shin made a promise with a girl who only visited the island for the summer. They promised to attend the same school when they grew up, so that they could always be together. This childhood memory and innocent promise faded as the months and years passed by. However, everything changed when he saw a photo of a student council president in one of the school brochures which he was leafing through. He decided to enrol in that school, the promised school.

item.title: Id -Rebirth Session-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: rootnuko
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (30 人評価)
  • 日本語名: id［イド］－Rebirth Session－
  • 英語名: Id -Rebirth Session-

あらすじ

Shirou runs a detective office. One day, Sakura visits his office. She is actually a younger sister of Shirou’s old friend. “I would like you to find my older brother…”

There is a cafe near his office called Cafe Seaside, it is located in an isolated place. A rumor about the cafe spreads through the internet and people start gathering the cafe, 12 boys and girls. The master of the cafe in mask tells them about his plan, then they get on a ship and arrive on a small island. But what for? Various mysterious cases., endless serial killing, who is the culprit…?
